verdict.rationale: Gitea Actions lets users write YAML workflows whose syntax is compatible with GitHub Actions, which strongly implies event-triggered automation rules. Webhooks extend this to custom workflows. However, the evidence never explicitly lists which events trigger workflows or describes rule configuration. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of supported trigger events and conditions, hands-on or independent corroboration of event-triggered automation, any automation rules beyond CI/CD workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Gitea Actions supports CI/CD functionality, compatible with GitHub Actions. Users can write workflows in familiar YAML format and reuse a variety of existing Actions plugins.
Workflow and action syntax is compatible with GitHub Actions.
Extend Gitea's functionality with our API and webhooks, creating custom workflows to match your unique needs.
